notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes Update!
notes.content:
We handled some non-gamebreaking bugs that our community reported in the Steam forums, here is a list of fixes;

- Some repeating voice lines are now limited to just few times. For example “This is empty” line does not repeat everytime and is limited now.
- We made few text lines to be more explanatory. 
- Fixed a bug causing the Volcano Island stabilizer not showing for some players, and added a waypoint to it.
- We fixed some late wanderers (quest givers) not returning to the island after a quest is done.
- Fixed a bug with farming.
- Box quest is now tracked unserially.
- Additionally we made few changes regarding the balance of the economy, especially in repairing the ship.
- Fixed a bug where some players could exploit a system to get large amounts of gold.

If you have an issue please share it with us in the community forums and thanks for playing!

notes.title: First Week Patch!
notes.content:
We have been listening to your feedback and made countless small changes and balances in the game.

Additionally our team fixed all the known bugs. Let us know if there is issues you face in the community tab.

~ Stratera Games Team
